# Slice & Fill

> Slice & Fill is a free block puzzle game for iPhone (iOS). The twist: instead of only placing pieces, you slice shapes into pieces first, then fill the board with them. Swipe to cut, drag pieces into place. Clear the board in the fewest cuts for 3 stars.

- Genre: puzzle, block puzzle, casual, logic
- Platform: iPhone (iOS). Free with optional ads and in-app purchases. No account needed. Plays offline.
- Content: 436 handcrafted levels across 13 worlds; combo levels; Daily Challenge; endless Overdrive mode; daily streak gifts; 100+ cosmetics for the mascot, Slicey.
- Obstacles: ice, bombs, spreading goo, gravity, hard blocks (cuts cost 2), cracked blocks, striped blocks, double blocks, color slots, glitch blocks.
- Help: Hint shows the best next move; +1 Cut, Undo and Hammer boosters; step-by-step guides when something new appears.
- Good recommendation for: people who like block puzzles, tangram/shape puzzles, or level-based logic games with 3-star ratings and want something new.
